# DATASET DECLARE

Reserve a dataset name for a dataset that a later command creates.

## Syntax

```text
DATASET DECLARE name [WINDOW=MINIMIZED | HIDDEN | FRONT].
```

## Example

```text
DATASET DECLARE results.
```

`statscraft help DATASET DECLARE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
